sky cinema premiere.title: The Fix
sky cinema premiere.desc: Disillusioned by the end of the war in Afghanistan, a group of disgraced, war-torn ex-CIA operators set out for Tehran to take down a life-changing score.

sky cinema premiere.title: Hamlet
sky cinema premiere.desc: An electrifying reimagining of Shakespeare's Hamlet, starring Riz Ahmed and set in the world of a British South Asian family in contemporary London.

sky cinema premiere.title: One Last Shot
sky cinema premiere.desc: Navy Seal Jake Harris must stop a team of mercenaries, led by his disillusioned former comrade, from disabling the US missile defence network.

sky cinema premiere.title: Mother's Pride
sky cinema premiere.desc: About a failing pub, a divided community, and a grieving family whose lives are changed by brewing real ale and entering the Great British Beer Awards.

sky cinema premiere.title: Hitpig!
sky cinema premiere.desc: A clever bounty-hunting pig must return a dancing elephant to a Las Vegas circus to collect $1 million. However, when the mission goes sideways, he soon realises that no amount of money is worth losing his newfound friends.

sky cinema action.title: The Italian Job
sky cinema action.desc: A group of petty criminals plan to rig a major traffic jam to divert attention from their bank heist.

sky cinema action.title: 300: Rise of an Empire
sky cinema action.desc: Greek Gen. Themistocles leads the charge to fight invading Persian forces led by the god Xerxes -- once a mortal -- and Artemisia.

sky cinema action.title: The Mummy Returns
sky cinema action.desc: The evil mummy Imhotep returns to wreak havoc as he resumes his relentless search for power and immortality. To make matters worse, another ancient evil has been unleashed, even more dangerous than Imhotep. Only the heroic Rick O'Connell and his intrepid Egyptologist wife stand in the way of these twin terrors as they embark upon a desperate mission to save the world.

sky cinema action.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
sky cinema action.desc: Mikaela and Sam once again join forces with Optimus Prime again to save Earth from ruthless robot The Fallen.

sky cinema action.title: Olympus Has Fallen
sky cinema action.desc: America's national security team must rely on a disgraced former guard to save the president after terrorists seize control of the White House, taking the chief of state hostage.

sky cinema family.title: Lemony Snicket's A Series of Unfortunate Events
sky cinema family.desc: Three orphans are sent to live with their uncle Count Olaf, but he only wants their family fortune. What follows is a battle of wits.

sky cinema family.title: Peter Rabbit
sky cinema family.desc: Peter Rabbit and his three sisters -- Flopsy, Mopsy and Cotton-Tail -- enjoy spending their days in Mr. McGregor's vegetable garden. When one of McGregor's relatives suddenly moves in, he's less than thrilled to discover a family of rabbits in his new home. A battle of wills soon breaks out as the new owner hatches scheme after scheme to get rid of Peter -- a resourceful rabbit who proves to be a worthy and wily opponent.

sky cinema family.title: Peter Rabbit 2
sky cinema family.desc: Despite his efforts, Peter can't seem to shake his reputation for mischief among the other rabbits. Once he adventures out of the garden Peter finds himself in a world where mischief is appreciated, but soon his family come to bring him home.

sky cinema family.title: Jumanji
sky cinema family.desc: Alan Parrish disappeared as a young boy. Nobody believes his friend's story that he was sucked into the game they were playing. Twenty-six years later, two children find the game in their attic, and when they start to play, Alan is released, but the game isn't over yet, and Alan must finish before he is really free.

sky cinema comedy.title: About Last Night
sky cinema comedy.desc: Four Los Angeles singles experience undeniable chemistry and pair off to follow their attraction to its logical conclusion. Afterward, each new couple tries to make love last in the real world.

sky cinema comedy.title: Beverly Hills Cop III
sky cinema comedy.desc: Axel Foley and his Beverly Hills buddies investigate criminal activities at a Southern California amusement park.

sky cinema comedy.title: Panda Plan
sky cinema comedy.desc: An action movie star must protect baby pandas from a group of mercenaries.

sky cinema comedy.title: Panda Plan 2: The Magical Tribe
sky cinema comedy.desc: Jackie Chan and panda Hu Hu stumble upon a hidden jungle society that hails the panda as a "divine beast." Jackie must face a group of tribal warriors to protect his panda friend and uncover the ancient secrets of the mysterious land.

sky cinema comedy.title: Mother's Pride
sky cinema comedy.desc: About a failing pub, a divided community, and a grieving family whose lives are changed by brewing real ale and entering the Great British Beer Awards.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Redux Redux
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A distraught woman travels through parallel universes to kill her daughter's murderer over and over again. With each death, she grows more and more addicted to revenge, putting her own humanity in jeopardy.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Army of Darkness
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Ash is transported back to medieval days, where he is captured by the dreaded Lord Arthur. Aided by the deadly chainsaw that has become his only friend, Ash is sent on a perilous mission to recover the Book of the Dead, a powerful tome that gives its owner the power to summon an army of ghouls.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Total Recall
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: In the late 21st century, a factory worker visits a company that implants fake memories. However, after his procedure he struggles to tell real and fabricated thoughts apart.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Cold Storage
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A highly contagious and rapidly mutating microorganism starts to multiply as it unleashes its brain-controlling, body-bursting terrors at a former military base.

sky cinema thriller.title: Hungry
sky cinema thriller.desc: After becoming lost in the Louisiana swamplands, a group of holidaymakers must fight for their lives against a rampaging hippo on the loose.

sky cinema thriller.title: The Bourne Legacy
sky cinema thriller.desc: Enhanced CIA assassin Aaron Cross faces a battle to survive when his CIA employers decide to do away with his programme.

sky cinema thriller.title: Snatch
sky cinema thriller.desc: Based on three hybridising narrative strands, three groups of villains are intent on retrieving a missing diamond. Turkish and Tommy team up with a pugilistic Irish gypsy named Mickey for the purpose of rigging unlicensed boxing matches. However, their opponent also arranges some dodgy betting with the courier of the stolen diamond, who subsequently goes missing. To complicate further, a New York gangster arrives on the scene.

sky cinema thriller.title: Revolver
sky cinema thriller.desc: Jake Green is a hotshot gambler, long on audacity and short on common sense. Jake served seven years in jail for a crime he didn't commit after taking the rap for mean crime boss Dorothy Macha. Upon his release he takes on Macha in a private casino game, causes humiliation, and wins. While Macha puts out an order on Jake's life, Jake meets brothers Avi and Zach who protect him and plot to take Macha down.

sky cinema greats.title: My Girl
sky cinema greats.desc: Moving tale about an 11-year-old tomboy growing up in the 1970s. The girl harbours the secret belief that she is responsible for her mother's death in childbirth, and is troubled by her father's new relationship with a beautician at his funeral parlour. However, the girl finds a way through her emotional difficulties with the help of her best friend.

sky cinema greats.title: Uncle Buck
sky cinema greats.desc: A bungling bachelor becomes a last-minute babysitter. Buck's brother's three children are foisted on him when the parents are called away from home indefinitely. Although he seems to be an unsuitable guardian, Buck turns out to have an unexpected knack for parenting, but he must work hard to prove himself, especially when he needs to save his eldest niece from her unsavoury boyfriend.

sky cinema greats.title: Smokey and the Bandit
sky cinema greats.desc: Tongue-in-cheek tale about a high-speed car chase across America involving a sheriff and a bootlegger with crash stunts galore. All goes well for the Bandit as he drives from Texas to Georgia with a truckload of illicit beer until he stops to pick up a damsel in distress, who also happens to be the sheriff's daughter.

sky cinema greats.title: The Breakfast Club
sky cinema greats.desc: Five school kids - an athlete, a spoiled rich kid, a brainy nerd, an introverted loner and a rebellious punk - are brought together on a day-long detention where they break the rules, bare their souls and find they have more in common than just attending the same high school.

sky cinema drama.title: Escape to Victory
sky cinema drama.desc: When ex-German international and camp commandant Van Steiner suggests a match between the POWs and the Germans, it swiftly escalates into a propaganda exercise.

sky cinema drama.title: Bohemian Rhapsody
sky cinema drama.desc: Singer Freddie Mercury defies stereotypes and convention to become one of history's most beloved entertainers. After leaving Queen to pursue a solo career, Mercury reunites with the band for one of the greatest performances in rock 'n' roll history.

sky cinema drama.title: Quartet
sky cinema drama.desc: A long-smouldering flame is rekindled when a once-popular opera star reunites with her ex-husband and fellow performers at a retirement home for musicians.

sky cinema drama.title: The Boy in the Striped Pyjamas
sky cinema drama.desc: When his father's job results in a family move to the countryside, young German boy Bruno misses his old friends. Roaming the grounds of the large country house he now calls home, he discovers the huge fenced facility that his dad Ralf, a Nazi officer, now manages. Approaching it, Bruno meets Shmuel, a fellow youngster on the other side of the barbed wire, wearing what appears to be a pair of pyjamas.

sky cinema drama.title: Rocketman
sky cinema drama.desc: Set to his most beloved songs, it's the epic musical story of Elton John, his breakthrough years in the 1970s and his fantastical transformation from shy piano prodigy to international superstar and pop icon.
